results.title: UK unemployment rate rises to 4.5% as labour market begins to weaken | Quilter Media Centre
results.snippet: “While the labour market has been surprisingly resilient thus far, this latest print may prove to be the start of the expected slowdown. The unemployment rate ticked up slightly to 4.5% in January to March 2025, while payrolled employee numbers fell by 47,000 between February and March 2025 and by 63,000 between March 2024 and March 2025. Job vacancies also dropped by 42,000 on the quarter to 761,000 in February to April 2025, marking the 34th consecutive quarterly decline.
